studies.name: The O/A ligature
studies.prompt:
Use case: style-transfer. Asset: ONE complete Olivia Arcana tarot card BACK artwork, portrait ratio 7:12, full bleed, front-on orthographic, no surrounding scene, no mockup, no perspective, no labels outside the artwork. Reference image role: MATERIAL AND PALETTE REFERENCE ONLY, not a layout template. Keep its midnight lapis blue, warm ivory shallow carved inlay, soft tactile satin finish, tiny restrained antique-gold details. The user rejected previous variations because they changed almost nothing. RADICALLY REDRAW the composition and ornamental topology. Do not preserve the three vertical columns of repeated flame/teardrop shapes. This must read immediately as a new authored card back belonging to OLIVIA ARCANA, not a generic decorative wallpaper. No 3D plastic, no glossy inflated shapes, no cheap glowing effects, no distressed dirt or spurious stars, no literal tarot scenes, no computer fonts overlaid on the pattern. Detailed craft with broad restful areas and fine-to-bold hierarchy. Use visually two-way, opposed construction suitable for a reversible tarot reverse. All corners and edge structure clean and deliberate. Opaque image.
DESIGN 09 — THE O/A LIGATURE.
Create a striking, unmistakable bespoke O/A identity built into the ENTIRE back. A large elongated oval O formed from a continuous ivory ribbon interlocks with a sharply tapered sweeping A with a clearly constructed diagonal and fine crossbar. The O and A must be identifiable, exquisitely drawn, not a random leaf pretending to be initials. Place this unique intertwined O/A in the upper half of the card, with its exact opposed companion rotated 180 degrees in the lower half; the two sweep together through the card's centre. Each monogram fills about one third of the card height. The joined monogram tails become elegant long arc contours that flow to the corners and create only four large open blue compartments. A slender ivory boundary ribbon follows a rounded rectangular inset frame and is woven through at four deliberate points. No small repeated tessellation. Much more blue negative space than reference, overall about 70% blue and 28% ivory, 2% old gold. Fine gold follows selected inside curves of the O only. Extremely fine shallow carved grooves on broad ivory surfaces, gentle relief shadow in the lapis. The effect is rare early-modern bookbinding marquetry with confident custom calligraphy: bold, beautifully proportioned, ornamental but the initials are the design. No words beyond the OA forms.

DESIGN 10 — THE OLIVE LATTICE.
Design a completely new flowing DIAGONAL olive bower lattice: two pairs of sinuous slender ivory olive branches travel in opposing S-curves from corners, crossing with convincing alternating over-under joinery into an open diamond network. Exactly three large open elongated DIAMOND-shaped blue voids aligned vertically, with smaller clipped diamonds at the side edges. Avoid any teardrop or flame silhouettes. Every branch has elegant narrow lanceolate olive leaves naturally branching with fine central veins; leaves smaller and more botanically convincing than reference's huge leaf-ribbons, varied subtle blue-on-blue leaves in the ground. Only four tiny paired gold olives at selected intersections. The ivory branches and leaves occupy about 35% of surface; rich shadowed blue negative spaces 63%. Fine sweeping olive stems continue into a distinctly finished quiet perimeter, a single very slender gold inset hairline with ivory corners, no thick ornate frame. Strong two-way construction, top and bottom opposed. Artful leaf spacing, delicate stem taper, intelligent branch connections, absolutely no disconnected leaves, no heraldic crest or central circular emblem. Card back must feel like a completed piece of inlay, with large readable geometry at thumbnail size and exquisite believable carved texture close up. Original Olivia identity comes through the olive organism and disciplined O-like interlocking arcs, not pasted logo. No text.

DESIGN 11 — THE BOTANICAL SEAL.
Create a totally different card-back with powerful framed hierarchy, not an allover wallpaper. A deep dark lapis central field with TWO large opposed open oval olive emblems, upper and lower, interlocked very lightly at the waist. Each emblem is a single slender ivory olive bough bent into an incomplete O, with elongated graceful lanceolate leaves, an elegant precision taper and two small gold olive fruits. Within each open O, a tall spare carved ivory A is constructed from a single curved main stroke and a fine cut/crossbar, the lower emblem rotated exactly 180 degrees. The ivory monogram and bough must be clear and legible, original calligraphic drawing. Surround the two large emblems with an exceptionally fine, dense BLUE-ON-BLUE engraved flowing leaf field, low contrast, all connected. A broad dramatic ivory corner sweep at each of the four corners connects to a NARROW interlaced botanical ivory border around the deep blue field; each corner has tailored blue cutouts, small gold inlay at junctions, and leaves echo the emblems. Leave breathing space around the two central O/A emblems. Surface shallow bas relief, restrained ivory, no chunky piping. Main design should read as a sophisticated reversible playing-card back at a glance, with a recognisable Olivia Arcana signature repeated twice and complex quiet perimeter. No words, no shields/crowns, no additional glyphs, no stars or celestial clichés. Frame and twin seals distinguish it completely from reference.
